notes: About: launched 2002 by Kendra with $500; still operates out of Austin, Texas; 'celebrated for its design and material innovation, vibrant use of color, and signature silhouettes'; custom stone silhouettes; Kendra Scott Foundation (2023), $65M donated.

FAQ: fashion jewelry is 14k gold or rhodium plated over brass, and the plating can fade with wear; vermeil is sterling silver plated with just over 2.5 microns of 18k gold. Necklaces metal facet also lists 14k yellow/white gold (94 items) and gold-filled. Authorized online retail partners listed include Dillard's, Macy's, Nordstrom and Anthropologie (about 19 in all).

Shipping: free on orders $85+ (banner; Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico excluded); standard 2–4 business days after processing. Returns: 30 days, unworn with tags, free return shipping; final sale = engraved, Color Bar custom, gift cards, marked-down. Holiday: 11/1/26–1/1/27 purchases returnable to 1/31/27.

International (Global-e): ships to more than 175 countries (not listed); duties prepaid or on delivery; no free shipping or free returns; Canadian shoppers get duties refunded on returns (so CA stored). GB/AU not named, not stored.
